item.tib: bder gshegs spyi spungs dgongs pa 'dus pa'i rgyud las bskang bshags 'dod 'byung gter gyi bum bzang
item.coloph: ces bon sgo theg pa rim dgu'i yangs bcud/ spyi spungs gsas mkhar sum brgya drug bcu'i dgongs pa gcig tu 'dus pa/sgrub gzhung rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum du byung ba'i cha lags (lag) rnam pa dgu yi nang nas bskang (skong) ba'i cho g-i zab mo 'di ni/ bla chen dran pa nam mkha'i (mkhas) thugs bskyed kyi mthu la/ sngon gnas rjes dran gyi gsal snang shar ba bzhin smon rgyal sems dpa'i ming 'dzin gzhan phan g.yung drung 'byung gnas du 'bod pa bdag gis bstan 'gros ('gror) lhag bsam dag pa'i sgo nas bris pas rgyal bstan yun du gnas shing 'gro kun phan bde 'byung ba'i rgyu ru gyur cig/
